definitions.explanation: A condition caused by ingesting or being exposed to a harmful substance. Used in medical and everyday contexts.
An obsessive dependence on a substance or activity. Often used figuratively and casually to describe being unable to stop doing something.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the original medical meaning — actual poisoning from toxic substances. Sense 2 is a figurative extension meaning addiction or obsessive attachment, used both seriously (drug/alcohol addiction) and casually (game/coffee addiction). Often appears as a suffix: ～{中毒|ちゅうどく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧ (food poisoning)
- {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}{中毒|ちゅうどく} (carbon monoxide poisoning)
- アルコール{中毒|ちゅうどく} (alcoholism)
- {中毒|ちゅうどく}⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧ (poisoning symptoms)
- {中毒|ちゅうどく}⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧ (poisoning patient)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{依存|いぞん}→依存：11441_izon⟧: dependence — more clinical and formal term for addiction
- {中毒|ちゅうどく}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧: addictive quality — describes the property of being addictive
